investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell was executed with Unrestricted policy and an encoded command, initiated by powershell.exe with a parent process of svchost.exe. The command references a module path under MTRP.PowerShell.Utils and uses a long encoded payload, which indicates obfuscation and potential attempt to evade detection. Hash reputation for the initiating process shows mixed community signals with more votes suggesting malicious, and there are no recent or similar alerts to provide historical context; combined, this activity is elevated and warrants investigation.
